iteration_disclosure: This design follows inspection of the earlier exit, exposure, earnings-blackout, 2024, and 2025 results. Every period is reused or contaminated for this revision; none is independent validation or an untouched holdout.
hypothesis: A point-in-time SPY entry gate and a causal ratcheting 20-session moving-average profit-protection stop, activated only after a trade first reaches 2R or 3R, may reduce portfolio drawdown without destroying the return and expectancy of the fixed-2R, structural-stop, 40-session baseline.
signal: MODEL_0 false-to-true Stage 2 eligibility transition after the close, followed by the mandatory inclusive ten-calendar-day pre-earnings blackout
entry: next available session open plus 5 bps adverse slippage

fixed_trade_plan.cash_and_notional_model: Normalized R; no cash or maximum-notional constraint

execution.same_bar_policy: Initial stop first; a trailing stop cannot activate until the session after the activation threshold was first observed
execution.trailing_indicator_availability: The stop used in session T is calculated only from completed bars through T-1
execution.trailing_ratchet: max(initial stop, every prior active trailing-stop level); the stop never loosens

market_gate_variants.definition: Admit signals regardless of SPY trend when other rules pass.

market_gate_variants.allow_when: SPY signal-date adjusted close > signal-date SMA50
SPY signal-date adjusted close > signal-date SMA200

market_gate_variants.normal_when: SPY signal-date adjusted close > EMA20, SMA50, and SMA200
market_gate_variants.reduced_when: SPY signal-date adjusted close > SMA200 but the normal condition is false
market_gate_variants.disclosure: This is a reproducible SPY-only proxy for normal/reduced/blocked exposure. It is not the production market-regime model, which also requires QQQ, breadth, breakout, leadership, and volatility inputs.

comparison_plan: For each market gate, compare every trailing variant with the no-trailing variant on the same stage. Also compare every cell with the no-market/no-trailing fixed-2R baseline. Report total return, CAGR, maximum daily open/close mark-to-market drawdown, expectancy, profit factor, win rate, payoff, trade count, heat, holding time, exit reasons, market-state admissions, and deltas. A return-improvement claim requires higher total return than the same-market no-trailing baseline in development, reused 2024, and reused 2025; mixed results must be labelled mixed.
decision_rule: Report all 28 cells across all three reused stages. End with HOLD, REVISE, or REJECT; do not advance to a new forward test or production because there is no independent validation or untouched holdout and the archives are biased.
constraints: Apply the earnings blackout before execution and portfolio allocation
Use market information available on the signal date only
A market heat reduction blocks new risk above the new limit but never force-closes an existing valid trade
Do not activate a trailing stop on the same bar that first reaches its activation threshold
Do not overwrite any earlier experiment or result
Do not change production or the immutable forward journal
